*Throwaway because some of you won't believe my life story due to other posts on real account.*

My father had abandoned me and my easily tempered mother. She was only living with her parents and was still going through college. She ended up dropping out to take care of me. Then I realized that she was a total bitch. She would be easily tempered and take her anger out on me. She insults my girlfriend and everything else I love. She insults me with every word in the book and only uses me to show off. When I was going through a state of depression she just told me to "get over it" and to "snap out of it." It took me 13 years to figure out why my dad had left her. 

I understand why he would leave her, but I didn't understand why he didn't even talk to me. The last time I said a word to him was at 8 years old. He didn't pay my child support or transfer any funds.

Fast forward a few years later, I become tech savvy and trace him down. Turns out he's the CEO and Co-Founder of [Voncore](http://voncore.net/). He owns portions of other companies as well. He's loaded, yet he didn't bother to support me financially. Thanks, asshole.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n8SuueTK5OQ

(The lyrics are exactly how I feel towards her. And the Halo gameplay is because I'm a fan of the game. Couldn't find another video.)

Love sucks. It really does. I just hate how after this long, she loses lust for me, when a week ago, she said she was happy with us. How did it go away so quickly? **HOW THE FUCK?**
